select_workspace.title: Select Workspace
select_workspace.description: Choose a workspace. If it has no service of the selected type, a seven-day trial will be created.

select_product.title: Select Product
select_product.description: Choose the product type to connect with this Home Assistant instance.

select_home.title: Choose a connection service
select_home.description: Only services of your selected type are shown. Choose the one to connect to this Home Assistant.

select_access.title: Select Security Access
select_access.description: Choose the security access to connect with this Home Assistant instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your woowtech authorization has expired or is missing required permissions. Select Submit to re-authorize.

user.title: Choose a connection service
user.description: Remote access connects you to Home Assistant from anywhere. Remote access + MCP also connects AI tools. After sign-in, missing workspaces and services are created with a seven-day trial. The trial pauses at expiry; paid use requires your choice. Choosing MCP automatically downloads and enables the woowtech MCP component. Its connection URL appears under device diagnostics.

progress.wait_for_device: Open {url} in a browser and enter the code {code}. Setup continues automatically once you authorize.
progress.prepare_service: Preparing your workspace and connection service. This may take a few minutes. Keep this screen open; retries reuse the same service.

create_entry.default: Connection setup for {name} is saved. Check the integration and remote connection status.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to woowtech platform. Please try again later.
error.insufficient_role: Only owners and admins of this workspace can connect it. Ask one of them to set up this Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This product instance is already configured.
abort.already_bound: This smart home is already connected to another Home Assistant installation ({bound_to}, since {bound_at}). Two installations must not share one tunnel: the public address would reach whichever answers first, so about half of all requests would land on the wrong machine. Release the binding in the woowtech portal, or pick the smart home that belongs to this machine.
abort.no_workspaces: No workspaces found for your account. Please create a workspace first.
abort.no_homes: No smart homes found in the selected workspace.
abort.no_accesses: No security accesses found in the selected workspace.
abort.device_authorization_failed: Device authorization failed or timed out. Please try again.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: Authorization was declined ({error}). Start the setup again if you want to connect.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout while resolving the OAuth token.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining access token.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timeout while generating an authorization URL.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url})
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: No OAuth2 implementations are currently available.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this product instance is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to woowtech platform. Please try again later.
abort.insufficient_role: Only owners and admins of this workspace can connect it. Ask one of them to set up this Home Assistant.
abort.onboarding_failed: Setup has not finished. Try adding the integration again shortly; existing records are kept. Check the service in [woowtech](https://aiot.woowtech.io/woow).
abort.trial_expired: The seven-day trial has ended. Choose a paid plan in [woowtech](https://aiot.woowtech.io/woow) to continue. Reconnecting does not restart the trial.
abort.mcp_ha_unsupported: Remote access + MCP requires Home Assistant 2026.6.0 or newer. Update HA first, or use remote access by itself.

instance_deleted.title: {name} was deleted on woowtech
instance_deleted.description: "{name}" no longer exists on the woowtech platform, so its tunnel has been stopped and its sensors are unavailable. Remove this integration entry under Settings → Devices & services → woowtech Smart Home. If the deletion was a mistake, this notice clears by itself once the platform reports the instance again.

mcp_ha_unsupported.title: Update Home Assistant
mcp_ha_unsupported.description: MCP requires Home Assistant 2026.6.0 or newer. Setup resumes after updating HA. Remote access continues independently.

mcp_install_failed.title: MCP installation is incomplete
mcp_install_failed.description: Check GitHub connectivity and configuration-directory write access. Setup retries every five minutes. Existing component files are preserved; repair an incomplete installation in HACS.

mcp_disabled.title: MCP server is disabled
mcp_disabled.description: Enable HA-MCP Server in Settings → Devices & services. Automatic setup respects a manually disabled server.

mcp_webhook_disabled.title: MCP remote access is disabled
mcp_webhook_disabled.description: Enable webhook access in HA-MCP Server options. The MCP URL appears in device diagnostics when the endpoint is ready.

mcp_setup_failed.title: MCP server setup is incomplete
mcp_setup_failed.description: Check HA-MCP messages in Settings → System → Repairs. Setup checks again every five minutes while remote access continues.
